newsitem.title: CROATIA: SOCCER-CROATIA V DENMARK WORLD CUP QUALIFIER TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATIA V DENMARK WORLD CUP QUALIFIER TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Saturday's World Cup group one qualifier between Croatia and Denmark:
Croatia - 1-Drazen Ladic; 23-Niko Kovac, 3-Robert Jarni, 14-Zvonimir Soldo, 5-Nikola Jerkan, 6-Slaven Bilic, 7-Aljosa Asanovic, 8-Robert Prosinecki, 9-Davor Suker, 10-Zvonimir Boban, 11-Alen Boksic.
Denmark- 1-Peter Schmeichel; 2-Jacob Laursen, 3-Marc Rieper, 4-Jes Hoegh, 5-Jan Heintze, 6-Thomas Helveg, 7-Per Frandsen, 8-Claus Thomsen, 9-Alen Nielsen 10-Mikkel Beck, 11-Brian Laudrup.
